name: Stage 2: Level Up Racing: BRAEk-fast Crits and Grits
description:
Level Up Racing is June’s ZRacing monthly series. Race across five stages from June 1 to July 5, with a new route each week and up to 250 XP waiting at every banner. Complete stages to build series progress, chase the GC leaderboard, and grab bonus XP as you race.

Stage 2

Dates: June 8–14
Route: BRAEk-fast Crits and Grits
Laps: 1
Distance: 22.1 km
Elevation: 243 m

Stage 2 brings BRAEk-fast Crits and Grits, a punchier test with more elevation and more chances to keep building XP. One lap, one effort, and another shot to add to your series total.

MONTHLY GC COMPETITION

Looking for extra motivation? The Monthly GC (General Classification) Competition lets you track your progress across all stages. Each race counts—your times add up throughout the series, shaping the overall standings. At the end of the month, the fastest total time takes the win!

VIEW RESULTS: http://zwift.com/racing/leagues/zracingjun2026
—------------------
Zwift Racing Score is aimed at pairing you with riders of similar racing abilities to keep racing fun, fair, and competitive. Read the FAQ here: https://support.zwift.com/en_us/racing-score-faq-BkG9_Rqrh


ADVANCED CATEGORY = 650+
CATEGORY RANGE 1 = 0-159 | 160-269 | 270-389 | 390-509 | 510-649
CATEGORY RANGE 2 = 0-209 | 210-329 | 330-449 | 450-569 | 570-724

For riders with a Racing Score of 650 or higher, the' Advanced' category will have separate events scheduled every other hour.

Please note that in order to enter the Advanced category, you will need the following:
Heart Rate Monitor
Zwift Racing Score of over 650
Smart Trainer/Bike or Power Meter


Hourly ZRacing will be split into five tighter categories for more exciting competition. Plus, with hourly alternating category ranges, you’ll have more options to find races that suit your level.

name: Mountain Massif structured training: Power Development (4 x 4-minutes)
description:
Created by Matt Rowe, from Rowe & King Coaching, this structured training session is designed to help you cycle at a higher intensity, and absorb surges in effort. 


For coaching and all your training needs visit https://roweandking.com/


About the session:
The benefit of this workout is the cumulative fatigue over the whole session, not the max effort of any single interval and is designed to enhance your power.


1. A progressive warmup. 
2. 4-minute TT effort (aim to ride this on feel - get 95% effort out, so you are not totally exhausted after each block) in a heavy gear (this is not a 55-60rpm effort, rather the gear should feel slightly large (e.g. one sprocket top big) i.e. 70-75rpm.  You should pace the effort, aiming to build the intensity throughout the effort to finish strong. Cadence circa 70rpm.
3. 5-minutes easy pedalling.  Repeat steps 2 and 3 a further 3 times (4 efforts in total).


Session details:
Ramp up in 6 steps:
• 3-minutes @ Zone 1-2
• 3-minutes @ Zone 2
• 3-minutes @ Zone 2-3
• 3-minutes @ Zone 2-3
• 3-minutes @ Zone 3
• 3-minutes @ Zone 3-4


Recovery:
• 2-minutes @ Zone 1


Repeat 4 times:
• TT 4-minutes @ Zone 5 (70-75 rpm)
• Easy 5-minutes @ Zone 1


Cool down:
• 4-minutes @ Zone 1


Safety Note:
Only undertake vigorous exercise if you are fit and healthy to do so. If you are at all unsure, consult a Physician or Doctor first.  All training equipment including Bikes and Turbo trainers should be in full working order. Do not use any piece of equipment that does not come up to the required standard.


More information:
For more information check out the Mountain Massif website www.mountainmassif.com, follow on Facebook, Instagram (Mountain_Massif) and join our Zwift Club by clicking the following link https://www.zwift.com/clubs/b639575d-930f-4de6-a79d-bea3313350bc/join.  To record all your training data and chart your progress, consider using the TrainingPeaks app (www.trainingpeaks.com/).

name: EVO CC Race Series
description:
CATEGORY ENFORCEMENT IS ENABLED FOR ALL EVO RACES!

What is Category Enforcement? 

Category Enforcement will prevent Zwifters from entering a category they are not eligible for.  Our goal is to increase fairness in racing.

HOW DOES IT WORK?

- Zwift checks a racer's past performance using VO2 max and FTP to determine their race category.
- Racers can join a category at or above their category. For example, if you are "C" category, you can race in C, B, or A category. You will not be able to race in the D category and the option to join will be absent.

Welcome to EVO race series. Start fast, hang on in the middle, then sprint for the win at the finish. Expect to push your heart rate to its maximum. Sprinkle a few of these into your training plan and watch your fitness grow.

To make racing as fair as possible we have enforced a few minor rules that will result in automatic disqualification on ZwiftPower.

All riders must wear a heart rate monitor
Riding in an incorrect category.

zPower riders will be disqualified in A, B, and C Podium. zPower is allowed in the D category. Race details and final results will be available at <http://www.zwiftpower.com/> http://www.zwiftpower.com

#evo

name: Team Italy Social SUB2 Ride
description:
WELCOME TO ALL RIDERS!
Team Italy Social SUB2 Ride is not a fast pace group ride or race.

RULES:
Please join us for our event for a pace between (1.8- 2.2 w/kg) for 60 mins.
The focus of the group ride is keeping the group together the entire ride.
Follow the ride Leader (yellow beacon) instructions at all times, the fence is the killer one, so if you don't respect the leader pace, it will kick you out, our advice is to join the sweeper behind the group if you have extra watts.

Staying in the group draft is very important.
Your jersey will be autoselected on the Zwift Christmas Kit .
Please, add tag [ITA] after your name.

SPRINTS:
Regroup right after optional sprints.
This is the Facebook group of Team Italy https://www.facebook.com/groups/zwiftitaly/
and Strava Club of Team Italy https://www.strava.com/clubs/zwift_italy
Join us! Have fun! Ride On!

-
BENVENUTO A TUTTI I RIDERS!
Team Italy Social SUB2 Ride non è una gara ma una pedalata di gruppo.

REGOLE:

name: PUMP: Loop Logic V — Friday (5 Laps)
description:
Same Distance. More Laps. Maximum Sass. ♥️🌶️

Welcome to Loop Logic, the weekday series where we prove that "going in circles" is actually a superpower. We’ve curated a week of routes that hit the 19–25km sweet spot with enough climbing to keep your glutes talking back to you.

The Logic is Simple:
We start with one big loop on Monday and add a lap every day until Friday. One lap is a warm-up, but five laps is a statement.

The PUMP Vibe:
Power in Numbers: No band here, ladies! This is your chance to find your rhythm, tuck into a friendly draft, and realize you’re much faster than you think.

Elevation is Our Love Language: Expect at least 100m of climb—just enough to feel the PUMP and earn that post-ride coffee.

Laughter > Watts: We ride hard, but we laugh harder. Whether you’re smashing a PR or just hanging onto a wheel for dear life, do it with a smile.

The Mission:
Show up for yourself, stay for the sisterhood, and let’s show exactly what women-powered logic looks like.

name: ZZRC The Weekend Starts Here
description:
Welcome to our ZZRC Weekend Starts Here
2-2.5.This is a group ride, not a race, where we encourage riding together.

Our rides are open to all riders, the category enforcement merely allows us to ensure a safe and quality ride for you the riders and for our group.

In 2015 ZZRC was founded and are one of the oldest established clubs on Zwift .

YELLOW BEACON will pace between 2-2.5 on the ride , with a possible increase of watts on inclines or sprints , but the average for the whole ride will be as advertised.

We strongly promote group riding so on most of our rides we will use the Fence to help encourage that. Using a fence ensures that the ride is not over paced .

In the event of falling off the back of the main group , you will need to pace well over group pace to bridge the gap and catch .

This is where our awesome ZZRC sweeps and Ride Buddies will help you return to group using their draft. They will give you clear encouraging instructions to aid this process .

Our crew are a caring bunch who dedicate a lot of hours to this club , but want you to have the best ride experience on Zwift

You will be fully supported and encouraged throughout the ride by the Leader, Sweeps and Ride Buddies .

Our rides do not allow the use of TT Bikes as they do not draft and will require you to push harder on the ride, and in these instances our Sweeps will not be able to help you .

Mountain bikes operate very similarly, minimum draft so more watts (effort) will be required for the ride and any chase backs to group .

All our rides have a 30 minute late join feature which allows you to rejoin if you have technical issues or you find yourself out of the group in the early stages of the ride. Using this feature SHOULD teleport you back into the main group with our YELLOW BEACON .


We love to have a chat on our rides so join us on our dedicated discord channel
https://discord.gg/QdeS3PtXTX


TOP TIPS

1) Stay close to the ride leader (or just in front on climbs), don’t let a gap form and the elastic snap!

2) Stay away from the Fence – We don’t like to fry anyone

3) Most important of all . . . HAVE FUN AND ENJOY THE RIDE.

#zzrc

Don’t forget to join our ZZRC-We Pace Not Race Facebook page and our club on the companion app

name: GXY SHOOTING STARS [2.8-3.2 wkg] CAT C
description:
You are blasting your way through the Zwift Cosmos at around 3.0 w/kg for 75 minutes – right at the top end of Cat C.

This ride is designed for strong C-riders who are comfortable riding hard and holding wheels.

The mission: keep the Shooting Star intact as we travel through the Galaxy.

⚠️ This is an unswept ride – there are no sweepers. Once you lose the Meteor’s tail, space gets very cold very fast. Ride smart, stay together and help each other keep the group intact.

On the climbs, expect short warp-speed surges up to ~4.0 w/kg to keep the group moving and avoid splits.

name: ZZRC Goat Airlines Flight Sub 2
description:
Welcome to our ZZRC Goat Airlines Sub 2. This is a group ride, not a race, where we encourage riding together.

Our rides are open to all riders, the category enforcement merely allows us to ensure a safe and quality ride for you the riders and for our group.

In 2015 ZZRC was founded and are one of the oldest established clubs on Zwift .

YELLOW BEACON will pace between 1.7-1.9 on the ride , with a possible increase of watts on inclines or sprints , but the average for the whole ride will be sub 2 .

We strongly promote group riding so on most of our rides we will use the Fence to help encourage that. Using a fence ensures that the ride is not over paced .

In the event of falling off the back of the main group , you will need to pace well over group pace to bridge the gap and catch .

This is where our awesome ZZRC sweeps and Ride Buddies will help you return to group using their draft. They will give you clear encouraging instructions to aid this process .

Our crew are a caring bunch who dedicated a lot of hours to this club , but want you to have the best ride experience on Zwift

You will be fully supported and encouraged throughout the ride by the Leader, Sweeps and Ride Buddies .

Our rides do not allow the use of TT Bikes as they do not draft and will require you to push harder on the ride, and in these instances our Sweeps will not be able to help you .

Mountain bikes operate very similarly, minimum draft so more watts (effort) will be required for the ride and any chase backs to group .

All our rides have a 30 minute late join feature which allows you to rejoin if you have technical issues or you find yourself out of the group in the early stages of the ride. Using this feature SHOULD teleport you back into the main group with our YELLOW BEACON .


We love to have a chat on our rides so join us on our dedicated discord channel for our sub 2
https://discord.gg/RJ3dhbjCEp


TOP TIPS

1) Stay close to the ride leader (or just in front on climbs), don’t let a gap form and the elastic snap!

2) Stay away from the Fence – We don’t like to fry anyone

3) Most important of all . . . HAVE FUN AND ENJOY THE RIDE.

#zzrc

Don’t forget to join our ZZRC-We Pace Not Race Facebook page and our club on the companion app

name: Herd Summer Racing League
description:
Welcome to the Herd Summer Racing League (HSRL)

HSRL is a series of points races. The race format can be a little bit different week to week, but in most of the races you score points for your time on each of the segments (FTS), versus the times set by the other competitors. You also score bonus points for your finishing position in the race versus your competitors in your category. Each week the race format, segments and points for this race will be posted at the Herd Racing League facebook group and on the Herd Racing discord channel. 

General Classification
The points in each race are used to determine your ranking for the race. Your race rank determines how many league points you receive, with the winner scoring 50 points, 2nd place getting 49 and so on, down to 1 point for 50th place. Each week there are six different events to choose from - choose whichever suits your schedule best.

Schedule
1-3 May: Hilly Loop (1 lap, 9.3km) - ITT with Points segments
8-10 May: Scotland Smash (1 lap, 18.0km) - Points race FTS + FIN
15-17 May: Jarvis Seaside Sprint (2 laps, 27.8km) - Points race FTS + FIN
22-24 May: Yumezi Grit (2 laps, 19.1km) - Scratch race
29-31 May: Queens Highway After Party (1 lap, 19.8km) - Points race FTS + FIN
5-7 June: Climb Control (1 lap, 24.0km) - Points race FTS + FIN
12-14 June: Bon Voyage (1 lap, 31.4km) - Points race FAL + FIN
19-21 June: Stay Puft Pursuit (1 lap, 32.0km) - Points race FTS + FIN

Race rules:
Steering is disabled
Smarttrainer or powermeter required.
Cadence sensor required.
Heart rate monitor required.
No indoor bikes without controlled resistance (cadence=power).
Participants must be registered on zwiftpower.com to be included in the results.
For elite level performances the race organiser can request additional data to verify the performance.
For podium finishers in all categories: Zwift activities must be saved PUBLIC for verification.

For more information please see our Facebook Group: https://www.facebook.com/groups/zHerdRacing

Most groups will start slower and finish faster than the indicated pace. Feel free to mix in some intervals and race your friends. #pbt

description:
Level Up Racing is June’s ZRacing monthly series. Race across five stages from June 1 to July 5, with a new route each week and up to 250 XP waiting at every banner. Complete stages to build series progress, chase the GC leaderboard, and grab bonus XP as you race.

Stage 2

Dates: June 8–14
Route: BRAEk-fast Crits and Grits
Laps: 1
Distance: 22.1 km
Elevation: 243 m

Stage 2 brings BRAEk-fast Crits and Grits, a punchier test with more elevation and more chances to keep building XP. One lap, one effort, and another shot to add to your series total.

MONTHLY GC COMPETITION

Looking for extra motivation? The Monthly GC (General Classification) Competition lets you track your progress across all stages. Each race counts—your times add up throughout the series, shaping the overall standings. At the end of the month, the fastest total time takes the win!

VIEW RESULTS: http://zwift.com/racing/leagues/zracingjun2026

Zwift Racing Score is aimed at pairing you with riders of similar racing abilities to keep racing fun, fair, and competitive. Read the FAQ here: https://support.zwift.com/en_us/racing-score-faq-BkG9_Rqrh


ADVANCED CATEGORY = 650+
CATEGORY RANGE 1 = 0-159 | 160-269 | 270-389 | 390-509 | 510-649
CATEGORY RANGE 2 = 0-209 | 210-329 | 330-449 | 450-569 | 570-724

For riders with a Racing Score of 650 or higher, the' Advanced' category will have separate events scheduled every other hour.

Please note that in order to enter the Advanced category, you will need the following:
Heart Rate Monitor
Zwift Racing Score of over 650
Smart Trainer/Bike or Power Meter


Hourly ZRacing will be split into five tighter categories for more exciting competition. Plus, with hourly alternating category ranges, you’ll have more options to find races that suit your level.

name: Velos Monuments – The Double Series – Bite-sized race 1/2
description:
Velos Monuments Races proudly presents The Double Series, a unique Zwift race format where tactics, endurance, and adaptability come together.

Each race of our 4-week race series features two back-to-back races on the same circuit: first in the clockwise direction, then immediately after in reverse. The roads stay the same, but the racing changes completely—new lines, new efforts, and new opportunities.
The first race starts at 19:25 UK time (20:25 CET), followed by the second at 20:05 UK time (21:05 CET). After a short reset, you are back on the same course, but now everything feels different. What worked in the first race may not work in the second, making strategy and adaptability key.
This format is designed for all rider types. Sprinters can target explosive finishes, punchers and climbers can take advantage of subtle elevation changes, while diesel riders can push the pace over longer efforts. With two races in quick succession, it’s not just about speed—it’s about managing effort and performing again under pressure.
Whether you are racing for the win, pushing your limits, or just looking for exciting competition, The Double Series offers something for everyone. Bring your power, bring your tactics, and make sure you save something for the reverse.
We look forward to seeing you on the start line.

Smart Trainers - HRM

So be SMART and use a SMART trainer as your PRIMARY power source where you can....

FRR Code of Conduct
- We expect the best racing behavior from all riders, if riders have an issue then always contact race control via email first, we will investigate every request raised.
- In race we do not expect riders to abuse others, flag, report to race control, screen shot etc.... riders who ignore this will be DQ'd for the season
- Discord chat remains objective and banter - anything more will be removed and warnings/bans will be issued

And finally remember we all do this for fun and exercise so ride on and enjoy the FRR events....stay safe and if it starts to hurt then welcome to the fun zone...! 
(But stop if it really does hurt too much please!)

name: EVO CC Sprint Race Series
description:
CATEGORY ENFORCEMENT IS ENABLED FOR ALL EVO RACES!

What is Category Enforcement? 

Category Enforcement will prevent Zwifters from entering a category they are not eligible for.  Our goal is to increase fairness in racing.

HOW DOES IT WORK?

- Zwift checks a racer's past performance using VO2 max and FTP to determine their race category.
- Racers can join a category at or above their category. For example, if you are "C" category, you can race in C, B, or A category. You will not be able to race in the D category and the option to join will be absent.

Welcome to EVO sprintrace series. Shorter more compact races for the rider looking for an effective high intensity race. Start fast, hang on in the middle, then sprint for the win at the finish. Expect to push your heart rate to its maximum. Sprinkle a few of these into your training plan and watch your fitness grow.

To make racing as fair as possible we have enforced a few minor rules that will result in automatic disqualification on ZwiftPower.

All riders must wear a heart rate monitor
Riding in an incorrect category.

zPower riders will be disqualified in A, B, and C Podium. zPower is allowed in the D category. Race details and final results will be available at www.zwiftpower.com

name: Velos Monuments – The Double Series – Bite-sized race 2/2
description:
Velos Monuments Races proudly presents The Double Series, a unique Zwift race format where tactics, endurance, and adaptability come together.

Each race of our 4-week race series features two back-to-back races on the same circuit: first in the clockwise direction, then immediately after in reverse. The roads stay the same, but the racing changes completely—new lines, new efforts, and new opportunities.
The first race starts at 19:25 UK time (20:25 CET), followed by the second at 20:05 UK time (21:05 CET). After a short reset, you are back on the same course, but now everything feels different. What worked in the first race may not work in the second, making strategy and adaptability key.
This format is designed for all rider types. Sprinters can target explosive finishes, punchers and climbers can take advantage of subtle elevation changes, while diesel riders can push the pace over longer efforts. With two races in quick succession, it’s not just about speed—it’s about managing effort and performing again under pressure.
Whether you are racing for the win, pushing your limits, or just looking for exciting competition, The Double Series offers something for everyone. Bring your power, bring your tactics, and make sure you save something for the reverse.
We look forward to seeing you on the start line.

name: TEAM TYPE ONE STYLE Friday Fun Social Ride
description:
TEAM TYPE ONE STYLE is the UK’s first multi-sport team which is formed entirely
of athletes who live, ride, run, swim, race and most importantly thrive with
Type One Diabetes. To get us all through the year, TEAM TYPE ONE STYLE proudly
hosts this weekly social event every Friday at 19:30 UK Time which is open to
all, including those with functional as well as ornamental pancreases.

At TEAM TYPE ONE STYLE, we are united in one aligned ambition…
Shifting the Perception of Type One Diabetes

Type One Diabetes may be a lifelong condition, but with good support and
education, it is in no way life-limiting. We hope to help fill the gap for our
recreational and racing athletes by offering education and support across
various channels as well as providing inspiration to all.

Whilst we can’t be cured of Type One Diabetes, we can overcome this condition!
Here at this event, we look to prove that it doesn't hamper our ability to
perform at our best and compete at the top.

In this weekly event, if you're doing 1.0w/kg or 5.0w/kg you’re welcome to join
us in this supportive environment every week and push yourself to improve. We’ll
be keeping things social and keeping the fence on from time to time to keep us
all bunched up whilst we talk all things type one diabetes, then let you loose
for some intervals or max sprints as guided by our coaches.

You’ll be categorized by your existing Racing Score for fair competition. But don't worry – race results won't impact your score, keeping the pressure low and the fun high.

Sign up for the ultimate Friday night race – fun-filled, feel-good, and guaranteed to make your weekend start with a bang!

name: The Velos Klick - 1km Challenge
description: A klick is a military term for a distance of 1km, and so Team Velos brings you a challenge to complete 1km in the fastest time possible. We will change courses monthly (all Flat courses) and we will have winners from each category at the end of the month. Choose your bike very carefully as it could make all the difference, the challenge is available every night during the week use it as a warm up for a race or just use it to improve your 1km time or power figures, whatever just have fun.

name: Rhino Racing Short Crits
description:
Fast and fun criterium races with five race times every Tuesday, Thursday, Friday, and Saturday.
A power meter or smart trainer is required for entry. A ZwiftPower account is required to be counted in the official results.
View the calendar of all Rhino Racing events: https://www.zwift.com/uk/events/tag/rhinoracing
Do you enjoy these events? We want to hear from you. Share your feedback on the Rhino Racing Discord.
Interested in team racing? We do ZRL, Dirt Racing Series, Club Ladder, and WTRL TTT events. Join us! https://discord.com/invite/wPD4HJ6

name: NPRC - Run Every Day Powered By NoblePro
description:
Come and join the fastest growing running club on Zwift.  With a choice of 5 or 10k you can pick your distance. Whether you are a beginner or experienced runner come and join us, you can run at whatever pace you like, it’s not a race unless you want it to be!

Each day is a different route and as new routes are released the courses will change to allow you to bag that badge.

You will run in our in game NPRC jersey and if you complete the event you get to keep it to wear wherever you like.

We also hold special events where you can win an actual jersey to wear in real life.

NPRC Facebook – We have a facebook group where you can join and talk about all things running.  Share your stories and get help and advice.

https://www.facebook.com/groups/1223724692417314/

NoblePro: - We are a team focused on elevating running through our treadmills and digital platforms. We create treadmills loved by runners and the wider running community for quality engineered hardware features and advanced software integration to give you the freedom to train with the apps you love.
https://www.noble-pro.com/

Kinni:- In a fitness world where treadmill bluetooth integration can be a confusing place, we aim to provide you with the ability to effortlessly connect. You can run structured treadmill workouts, connect and integrate with your favourite bluetooth fitness apps such as Zwift, Rouvy, Kinomaps and many more. We are focused on progress and advancement in integration, connectivity and control.
https://kinni.co/https://kinni.co/devices/ - To see if your treadmill is compatible to link to Zwift.

Join the NoblePro Running Club (NPRC) - https://www.zwift.com/clubs/e7829ccd-bce4-4244-9ccf-4cdc3ef148ff/home

name: The WarmUp Ride
description:
From humble beginnings on Melbourne's Mornington Peninsula, ZMCC has grown to become a favourite hangout within the Zwiftverse. Whether you're looking to push yourself, recover or just spin around - ZMCC is always there for you. Bad dad jokes and questionable banter are just extras you can't buy.

We make the following promises:

We won't yell at the flyers - let them live their imaginary life.
We won't wait for stragglers - we can't help poor event choices or tech issues.
We won't bore or tease you with pretend drinks or snacks.

Join us. Enjoy. You're welcome.

Like and join us on Facebook at https://www.facebook.com/groups/zwiftmelbournecyclingclub

name: JETT Hill Climb & Interval Ride
description:
Welcome to Japan eSports Tempting Team's Hill Climb & Interval  training!

１．The signal is on Leader's [Go].
Be sure to stay behind the leader just before the sprint & KOM.
Immediately after the sprint & Climb , please make efforts to re-group immediately (1.0w/kg at the head and 2.0 to 2.5w/kg at the back). 
Since we want to return to base pace immediately after re-grouping, your cooperation with Regroup is essential.

２．Interval Training is ... Hard time: 3.5 w / kg to 6.0 w / kg ··· 2 minutes to 5 minutes
Follow the leader's power instructions and enjoy interval training.

In addition, mini races are also planned in the final stage!
Start is on my 'go'
Be sure to stay behind the leader before you start.

Ride On !!

* Please note that if you lead with abnormal speed, flag will be set.

Hill Climb Training!
SprintとIntervalを組み合わせてトレーニングを実施しますします。

１．スプリント& KOMの合図は、私の 【 Go 】です。
スプリン& KOM直前は、必ずリーダーの後ろにいてください。
スプリント&KOM直後は、すぐにリグループするよう努力してください(先頭は1.0w/kg、後方は2.0〜2.5w/kg)。リグループ後すぐに、ベースペースへ戻したいため、リグループへの皆さんのご協力は、不可欠です。
２．インターバルトレーニングは，ハードタイム：3.5w/kg~6.0w/kg・・・2分～5分
リーダーのパワー指示に従い，インターバルトレーニングを楽しみましょう。
なお、終盤にミニレースも予定してます！！
スタートは，リーダーの「GO」が合図です。スタート前に必ずリーダーの後ろにいてください。
Ride On !!

※異常なスピードでリードした場合、フラグを立てますのでご注意下さい。

#jett #japan

MONTHLY GC COMPETITION

name: AHDR FAB Rolls p/b JetBlack
description:
The weekend is upon us, so you know what that means - no Bacon Rolls! The time has come for the AHDR Full Aussie Brekkie Roll! Just like your favorite weekday morning treat, but bigger and better for Saturday morning. The kitchen opens at 0615 but be early as the “Full” sign goes up after 30 minutes. The buffet will cover longer courses with rolling terrain at a brisk endurance pace to satisfy your weekend craving. The kitchen will close after 2 hours but those who still have leftovers will have time to finish their course. The fence will be on, but the blob will rule the road. We will ride at around 2.5-3.0W/kg but will adjust this to the group as necessary. Please stay together as a group around the Beacon. It is a steady endurance ride, not a race. All are welcome - join us for as long as you want.

#ahdr

name: SROZ's The Lone Wolf Chrono
description:
Welcome to SROZ's Lone Wolf Chrono! This isn't about sitting in the wheels or playing tactics in the pack. This is a pure test of grit, pacing, and individual strength. Whether you are chasing a new Personal Best or just want to see where your fitness stands, this is your chance to empty the tank against the clock.

The Mission: One rider. One bike. Total focus.

Please ensure your weight and height are up to date. Heart Rate Monitors are required for podium contenders.

name: Fast Friday Workout
description:
Congratulations, you crushed another week of workouts! If you’re looking to cap off a great week with another can't-miss training session, check out Fast Friday on Zwift. 

A new workout series to put in your weekly run rotation, Fast Friday is a simple and streamlined way to get your heart rate up. We’re focusing on short reps here, clocking in fast intervals that help runners increase their top speed. Short. Sharp. Fast. High-intensity intervals are proven to take your performance to the next level. So lace up and get moving for just 20–30 minutes every Friday before checking out of the office and into the weekend. 

#fastfriday

name: The Saturday Shop Ride by Trek Australia
description:
Complete this ride to unlock the Trek Segafredo Training kit!

In March 2020 we turned the legendary Trek Melbourne Shop Rides into a Zwift event for "just a few weeks..." four years later we have an amazing global community who meet up every Saturday for all the banter, coffee, fast and slow fun of a social shop ride. We stop twice to regroup along the way to keep it social, and our leaders and sweepers ensure everyone who wants to can get to the end. And if 70.02km is too short, you can even stay on for some TrekStras!

If you're looking for a supportive community bunch ride, or even your first ride on Zwift this is the perfect place to Ride Bikes, Have Fun and Feel Good!

Check out our club Trek Australia New Zealand Ride Club to stay in the loop.

name: TBR 101 - Endurance
description:
The aim of TBR 101 is to help riders achieve a century (100 km) at a nice, chilled pack pace of around 36 kmh. Many riders think that they might never get to wear the Zwift Metric Century jersey – yet by sitting in our pack, with a group of experienced riders to assist, this is achievable. We try to be friendly, encouraging and concentrate on the core group around the beacon. If you wish to average faster than 36 kmh we suggest you look at other events such as Asia 120 that commences 2 hours after TBR 101. We have lots of laughs and banter – all helping to pass the time. We don't use the fence for this ride as we believe all riders should exercise self-control and respect the ride leader by riding with the yellow beacon at all times. Your co-operation helps us provide everyone with a fun, supportive and inclusive ride. Follow TBR at thebigring.cc to learn more about our events, read ride reports and leave feedback. Spotify https://open.spotify.com/playlist/4SKGVF1M70ccToY7RA82eR?si=9nX9SZZoRW-48dEPM59riw

#TBR

name: The XP Express
description:
All aboard The XP Express!

We're dishing out Double XP in this event so sign up, kit up and get ready to Level Up.

The XP Express is a turbocharged ride where every pedal stroke counts twice. Whether you're starting your Zwift journey or a seasoned pro, hop aboard to Level Up your ride.

How does it work?
The XP Express events will double your XP, helping you wrack up 40XP per kilometer or 64XP per mile! Leveling Up is the perfect way to unlock new swag, access to bikes and wheels, new routes and, of course, some bragging rights.

Use this event as an easy recovery ride, a quick warm up before your next race or push yourself to the limit to see how much XP you can earn.

name: Restart Esports - Happy Hour
description:
Restart Esports - instagram.com/restart.esports

1. Heart Rate Monitor (HRM) is mandatory for all participants.

2. Power Source is Mandatory for all racers. A smart trainer or smart bike should be your power source where possible. ZPower is not allowed. 

3. Dual Recording - Should always be done if you have the capability. All podium positions are expected to dual record or have at least have a recent dual recording history on their profile. Any rider posting high level performances is expected to validate their hardware with dual recordings as a minimum. 

Results WILL be amended (if required), in the interest of fair play, for all Restart Esports hosted events.

eventSubgroups.name: Restart Esports - Happy Hour (A)
eventSubgroups.description:
Join in on a new weekly race: the Restart Racing Sunday Classic.

Restart Racing is an eRacing team that likes to race hard and have fun. eSports gives us an amazing platform to better ourselves as bike racers and is a great way to make friends and enjoy ourselves. 

Each week will feature a different course ranging in distance from 50-70kms with a target finish time of around 1.5hrs. Please use ZwiftPower's Minimum Category on your profile for race entry.

Cats A & B riders require a power source (power meter or smart trainer) plus a heart rate monitor. Podium finishers in Cat A are expected to dual record and make analysis 'Public' on Zwift Power while using a direct drive trainer and power meter.
Cat C will require a power source (power meter or smart trainer) and a heart rate monitor for podium spots.

Cat A - 4.0+ (min 250W)
Cat B - 3.2 - 4.0 w/kg (min 200W)
Cat C - 2.5 - 3.2 w/kg (min 150W)
Cat D - 1.0 - 2.5 w/kg

name: RO4H Weekend Wander
description:
Welcome to the RO4H Weekend Wander.

The RO4H Weekend Wander is a social group ride hosted by the Ride On 4 Health community, where a friendly, casual, supportive, and respectful atmosphere embraces everyone from the most seasoned Zwifter to the first-time group ride participant.

This ride uses Zwift’s “Keep Everyone Together” (Rubberbanding) feature. Rubberbanding keeps everyone in the group together by adjusting in-game speed so riders of different power levels stay together. Your actual watts are still recorded, but speed and segment times won’t reflect normal in-game physics. Just ride at a comfortable effort and enjoy staying with the group from start to finish.

So come along for the RO4H Weekend Wander — you'll almost certainly break a sweat, undoubtedly hear a few dad jokes, and might even have some fun.

name: ZTBR - Training Stabilization TTT
description:
Zwift Teams Brazil [ZTBR] together with Assessoria Franklin Almeida, provides this training with a focus on providing better "Stabilization" in the performance of athletes seeking better performance in Team Time Trial (TTT) events.

This training aims to help the athlete tolerate and withstand an accumulation of substrates produced by the body in sub-maximal activities, bringing more stability and control in time-based tests.

Franklin Almeida Consulting was created in 2005, with the aim of evaluating the physiological profile, developing training to improve your physical capacity, health and maximum performance.
One of the pioneers in distance consulting in Brazil!

Note: We will have other phases of this training in addition to Stabilization, they are: (Training for FTP Gains and Terrain Variations).

Esse treino tem o objetivo de ajudar o atleta a tolerar e suportar um acúmulo de sustratos produzidos pelo organismo em atividades sub máximas trazendo mais estabilidade e controle em provas de conta relógio.

A Consultoria Franklin Almeida foi criada em 2005, com o objetivo de avaliar o perfil fisiológico, desenvolver treinos para melhorar sua capacidade física, sua saúde e desempenho máximo.
Um dos pioneiros em consultoria a distância no Brasil!

name: FRR Weekend Warrior Series - ITT
description:
Flamme Rouge Racing are excited to bring you our WEEKEND WARRIOR which build on the Classica races and the full series to mid August.

Each event will offer 3 races Friday to Sunday, using three formats - iTT / Scratch / Points - each race will convert to points, based on segments and finish - a riders points total will be drawn from all 3 races, do more, score more!

Each event will center around the type of course and terrain of the monument, with the actual race day event being of a length that is fitting for the monument.

Classica races are part of the FRR Weekend Warrior Race Series for which there will be at least 10 WW events, refer to website for the Schedule and rules:

Series Schedule
https://flammerougeracing.com/race-schedule/

Rules
https://flammerougeracing.com/race-rules

Event Basics
- Public events - MIXED RACING
- Five Max 30day ZRS ranged pens
- Mandatory racing experience - HRM - Smart Trainers


- Season long Order of Merit (OoM)
- Best 7 scoring events to count (an event counts the points from all 3 races over

FRR Registered riders form the OoM - Top 10 earn prizes on condition they are FRR Subscribers 

For all details, registration and how to become an FRR subscriber vist our website:
https://flammerougeracing.com/

Primary Communication via DISCORD

Discord - RACE channel for questions, updates and lively chat - it is by far the best place to clarify or report anything during the series

Invite link: https://discord.com/invite/nQNWHQK6PS

Smart Trainers - HRM
- Smart Trainers are mandatory
- Race Control can verify with the Zwift platform 
- HRMs are mandatory

So be SMART and use a SMART trainer as your PRIMARY power source where you can....

FRR Code of Conduct
- We expect the best racing behavior from all riders, if riders have an issue then always contact race control via email first, we will investigate every request raised.
- In race we do not expect riders to abuse others, flag, report to race control, screen shot etc.... riders who ignore this will be DQ'd for the season
- Discord chat remains objective and banter - anything more will be removed and warnings/bans will be issued

And finally remember we all do this for fun and exercise so ride on and enjoy the FRR events....stay safe and if it starts to hurt then welcome to the fun zone...! 
(But stop if it really does hurt too much please!)

A Consultoria Franklin Almeida foi criada em 2005, com o objetivo de avaliar o perfil fisiológico, desenvolver treinos para melhorar sua capacidade física, sua saúde e desempenho máximo.
Um dos pioneiros em consultoria a distância no Brasil!

name: Herd Summer Racing League
description:
Welcome to the Herd Summer Racing League (HSRL)

HSRL is a series of points races. The race format can be a little bit different week to week, but in most of the races you score points for your time on each of the segments (FTS), versus the times set by the other competitors. You also score bonus points for your finishing position in the race versus your competitors in your category. Each week the race format, segments and points for this race will be posted at the Herd Racing League facebook group and on the Herd Racing discord channel. 

General Classification
The points in each race are used to determine your ranking for the race. Your race rank determines how many league points you receive, with the winner scoring 50 points, 2nd place getting 49 and so on, down to 1 point for 50th place. Each week there are six different events to choose from - choose whichever suits your schedule best.

Schedule
1-3 May: Hilly Loop (1 lap, 9.3km) - ITT with Points segments
8-10 May: Scotland Smash (1 lap, 18.0km) - Points race FTS + FIN
15-17 May: Jarvis Seaside Sprint (2 laps, 27.8km) - Points race FTS + FIN
22-24 May: Yumezi Grit (2 laps, 19.1km) - Scratch race
29-31 May: Queens Highway After Party (1 lap, 19.8km) - Points race FTS + FIN
5-7 June: Climb Control (1 lap, 24.0km) - Points race FTS + FIN
12-14 June: Bon Voyage (1 lap, 31.4km) - Points race FAL + FIN
19-21 June: Stay Puft Pursuit (1 lap, 32.0km) - Points race FTS + FIN

Race rules:
Steering is disabled
Smarttrainer or powermeter required.
Cadence sensor required.
Heart rate monitor required.
No indoor bikes without controlled resistance (cadence=power).
Participants must be registered on zwiftpower.com to be included in the results.
For elite level performances the race organiser can request additional data to verify the performance.
For podium finishers in all categories: Zwift activities must be saved PUBLIC for verification.

For more information please see our Facebook Group: https://www.facebook.com/groups/zHerdRacing

name: Old Timers Tea Time Tour
description:
Old Dog Racing presents a series of shorter and easier races ideal for beginner and intermediate riders. It’s called the tea time tour but it could be breakfast, lunch, maybe even midnight snack wherever you are!  Absolutely everyone is welcome to join in, bring your friends and a nemesis or two!

Perhaps you are new; maybe the old power station isn’t delivering the watts anymore, or the knees are just a little too creaky, these races are for you!

Come and join the fun; A six week tour, two start times per week, Wednesdays 5:30 pm Eastern and  Fridays 5:30 pm Pacific, If you race both events in a week your best finish time will go towards your points total.

Races will be mass start and all riders visible, participants will be issued the Zwift Category kit as an aid to identify which category riders you are currently racing against.

The Categories are divided by age as shown below:
A Under 40 (red)  B 40-49 (green) C 50-59 (blue) D 60-69 (yellow) and E 70 and over. (purple)

If you haven’t tried age based (masters) racing before, they can be great fun, plenty of banter and friendly rivalry between the age groups!

Watch out for the olduns’ (yellow and purple)… They say you can’t teach an old dog new tricks, but what they don’t tell you is that they have a few stashed up their sleeves!

Power ups to help you along your way include: The van, the steamroller, the feather, and aero.

If you find yourself alone, enjoy the scenery and clock up another route badge.

Points awarded to each category in every race are: 25, 20,16,13,11,10,9,8,7,6 and 5 very generous participation points!! (You have to finish!). 

Highest accumulated points in each category wins the series.. you’re going to have to wear an HRM and have a Zwift Power account in order to be awarded points.

Earn more than 100 points and l’ll send you an Old Dog Racing Mug!*
The best race report of the series gets a mug too.* 

      *terms and conditions apply, go to Facebook page for details.

name: Friday Fearless Fartleks
description:
Fartlek, which means speed play in Swedish, is continuous training with interval training. Fartlek runs are a very simple form of a long distance run. Fartlek training is simply defined as periods of fast running intermixed with periods of slower running. For some people, this could be a mix of jogging and sprinting, but for beginners it could be walking with jogging sections added in when possible.

A good laugh and a long run are the two best cures for anything.

Join to challenge yourself and for the group run fun!

Hosted by Team Fearless. To hear about our other rides and runs or learn more about our women's team, head to our Facebook Fans page at https://www.facebook.com/groups/TeamFearlessZR/

name: FRR Weekend Warrior Series - ITT
description:
Flamme Rouge Racing are excited to bring you our WEEKEND WARRIOR which build on the Classica races and the full series to mid August.

Each event will offer 3 races Friday to Sunday, using three formats - iTT / Scratch / Points - each race will convert to points, based on segments and finish - a riders points total will be drawn from all 3 races, do more, score more!

Each event will center around the type of course and terrain of the monument, with the actual race day event being of a length that is fitting for the monument.

Classica races are part of the FRR Weekend Warrior Race Series for which there will be at least 10 WW events, refer to website for the Schedule and rules:

Series Schedule
https://flammerougeracing.com/race-schedule/

Rules
https://flammerougeracing.com/race-rules

Event Basics
- Public events - MIXED RACING
- Five Max 30day ZRS ranged pens
- Mandatory racing experience - HRM - Smart Trainers


- Season long Order of Merit (OoM)
- Best 7 scoring events to count (an event counts the points from all 3 races over

FRR Registered riders form the OoM - Top 10 earn prizes on condition they are FRR Subscribers 

For all details, registration and how to become an FRR subscriber vist our website:
https://flammerougeracing.com/

Primary Communication via DISCORD

Discord - RACE channel for questions, updates and lively chat - it is by far the best place to clarify or report anything during the series

Invite link: https://discord.com/invite/nQNWHQK6PS

Smart Trainers - HRM
- Smart Trainers are mandatory
- Race Control can verify with the Zwift platform 
- HRMs are mandatory

So be SMART and use a SMART trainer as your PRIMARY power source where you can....

FRR Code of Conduct
- We expect the best racing behavior from all riders, if riders have an issue then always contact race control via email first, we will investigate every request raised.
- In race we do not expect riders to abuse others, flag, report to race control, screen shot etc.... riders who ignore this will be DQ'd for the season
- Discord chat remains objective and banter - anything more will be removed and warnings/bans will be issued

And finally remember we all do this for fun and exercise so ride on and enjoy the FRR events....stay safe and if it starts to hurt then welcome to the fun zone...! 
(But stop if it really does hurt too much please!)

description:
Get ready for the Friday Night Fun Race – the perfect way to unwind and kick-off your weekend! This is fast, friendly, and totally unserious racing designed for pure enjoyment.

Every week brings a different course and theme, so you never know what fun-fueled surprise awaits! And if that wasn't enough, everyone starts with a 'BOOST' power-up, with extras available throughout the race – that’s a speed increase for a few seconds – use it wisely!

Races are held weekly on Friday evenings across various timezones.

name: The Zombie 5k
description:
Brought to you from the NoblePro Running Club (NPRC) this event is called the Zombie Run as for those in the UK this event is in the middle of the night.

Whether you are a beginner or experienced runner come and join, you can run at whatever pace you like, it's not a race.
If you don't want to run 5k then come along for as long as you wish, the support is always appreciated.
The event runs at the same time each day, Tuesday to Saturday and each day there is a different course.

NoblePro: - We are a team focused on elevating running through our treadmills and digital platforms. We create treadmills loved by runners and the wider running community for quality engineered hardware features and advanced software integration to give you the freedom to train with the apps you love.
https://www.noble-pro.com/

Kinni:- In a fitness world where treadmill bluetooth integration can be a confusing place, we aim to provide you with the ability to effortlessly connect. You can run structured treadmill workouts, connect and integrate with your favourite bluetooth fitness apps such as Zwift, Rouvy, Kinomaps and many more. We are focused on progress and advancement in integration, connectivity and control.
https://kinni.co/

name: Cycle Nation Endurance Chase Ride
description:
"Are you a Zwifter looking for a steady, enjoyable late-night or early morning group ride to boost your endurance and aerobic fitness? Look no further than the Cycle Nation Nightcrawler Ride, designed specifically for riders who prefer a consistent pace at sub 1.8w/kg. Scheduled twice a week, this ride is perfect for those aiming to build their stamina and improve their overall fitness.
Welcome to the Cycle Nation Endurance Chase Ride. Join us for an exciting pursuit, where one group will chase the other across the desert.
The first yellow beacon will lead the C group out at the start of the ride, and will ride at 2.5-3.1w/kg for the duration. The second yellow beacon will start 3 minutes after the start time, leading the B group at 3.1-4.0w/kg until they catch the first group. Connect with Cycle Nation:

name: Cycle Nation Endurance Ride
description:
Welcome to the Cycle Nation Endurance Rides. Join us for our series of weekend endurance rides aimed at Zwifters looking for group rides from 100km up to 300km. All riders are welcome to join the event and enjoy the friendly atmosphere and share banter. These are #DoubleDraft rides and as such it really helps if you try and stay in the main bunch and enjoy the draft. We ask that all riders respect the ride pace and stay around the leaders yellow beacon and not ride off the front.

This is NOT A RACE but a group endurance ride . Form groups and settle at a pace that suits you or ride along and follow the ride leaders instructions. Stronger riders are encouraged to assist with sweeping duties.

name: ZTPL Cycling Club Psycho Poranek Endurance Ride
description:
Zapraszamy na wspólny poranny event z ZTPL Cycling Club.
Z założenia nasze jazdy prowadzą liderzy, którzy pomagają trzymać peleton w ryzach. Jeśli podczas eventu zabraknie lidera, starajcie się trzymać tempo na które się umówiliśmy w momencie gdy dołączyliście do wybranej grupy. To od Was zależy jak będziecie się bawić 😊
Po ukończonym evencie, jeśli jechaliście z nami pierwszy raz, w Waszym wirtualnym garażu będzie czekała nasza teamowa koszulka!

◾️ Wartości podane w opisach dotyczą średniego tempa z CAŁEJ jazdy (nie uwzględniają interwałów, które mogą wystąpić podczas np. podjazdów)
◾️ PAMIĘTAJCIE, że podczas jazd grupowych NIE UŻYWAMY ROWERÓW CZASOWYCH!
◾️ Starajcie się pilnować peletonu i nie zgubić koła, samemu bardzo trudno jest odrobić stratę.
◾️ Proszę słuchajcie poleceń lidera, które podczas jazdy wyświetlane są na środku ekranu. Szczególnie jeśli lider zauważy że grupa się porwała.
◾️ Lider, który prowadzi grupę podświetlony jest na żółto.
◾️ Starajcie się jechać blisko lidera, starając się go nie wyprzedzać i nie wyjeżdżać przed bramę, która informuje Was że jedziecie za szybko.

◾️Podoba się Wam to co robimy? Zawsze możecie postawić Waszym kochanym administratorom oraz liderom naszych jazd wirtualną kawę :) https://buycoffee.to/ztplcc

description:

Each event will center around the type of course and terrain of the monument, with the actual race day event being of a length that is fitting for the monument.

Classica races are part of the FRR Weekend Warrior Race Series for which there will be at least 10 WW events, refer to website for the Schedule and rules:

Rules
https://flammerougeracing.com/race-rules

Event Basics
- Public events - MIXED RACING
- Five Max 30day ZRS ranged pens
- Mandatory racing experience - HRM - Smart Trainers


- Season long Order of Merit (OoM)
- Best 7 scoring events to count (an event counts the points from all 3 races over

FRR Registered riders form the OoM - Top 10 earn prizes on condition they are FRR Subscribers 

For all details, registration and how to become an FRR subscriber vist our website:
https://flammerougeracing.com/

Primary Communication via DISCORD

Discord - RACE channel for questions, updates and lively chat - it is by far the best place to clarify or report anything during the series

Invite link: https://discord.com/invite/nQNWHQK6PS

Smart Trainers - HRM
- Smart Trainers are mandatory
- Race Control can verify with the Zwift platform 
- HRMs are mandatory

So be SMART and use a SMART trainer as your PRIMARY power source where you can....

FRR Code of Conduct
- We expect the best racing behavior from all riders, if riders have an issue then always contact race control via email first, we will investigate every request raised.
- In race we do not expect riders to abuse others, flag, report to race control, screen shot etc.... riders who ignore this will be DQ'd for the season
- Discord chat remains objective and banter - anything more will be removed and warnings/bans will be issued

And finally remember we all do this for fun and exercise so ride on and enjoy the FRR events....stay safe and if it starts to hurt then welcome to the fun zone...! 
(But stop if it really does hurt too much please!)

name: Vitality for UNICEF Group Ride
description:
Vitality, in partnership with UNICEF, is teaming up with Zwift for a series of great social rides for a fantastic cause. Don’t miss out. Join our social rides of 45 minutes to one hour and do your part to give kids a head start. Keeping you active and helping Vitality and UNICEF vaccinate millions of children worldwide.

We encourage everyone to stay together for this social ride. Every ride completion will help UNICEF vaccinate a child against polio.

About Vitality:
 
Guided by a core purpose of making people healthier, Vitality is the leader in shared-value by creating healthy behavior changes in insurance. By blending technology, data, incentives, and behavioural science, Vitality inspires healthy changes in individuals and organizations. 

In partnership with UNICEF, Vitality aims to vaccinate millions of children against polio by donating vaccines on behalf of participants who complete the Vitality for UNICEF Ride series events.

Furthermore, the partnership with Zwift has been established as part of Vitality’s global pledge to get 100 million people 20% more active by 2025 through incentives to live healthier, more active lifestyles.

name: INC Relentless Endurance Intervals
description:
Innovation cycling club (INC) offers you one of his relentless ultra intervals to boost your fitness in a nice and friendly atmosphere. Get in the Alien train to improve your long distance fitness and challenge yourself with fabulous DIY workouts based on ground variations.

GROUP B: 6:00am gmt Distance: 100km - Base Pace 2.8-3.0 W/kg, Intervals 3.5-4.0 W/kg ETA: 2:15 2:30

GROUP C: 6:02am gmt Distance: 80km - Base Pace 2.5-2.8 W/kg Intervals 3.0-3.6 W/kg ETA 2-2:15

Sometimes higher short efforts and sprints could be included. show up in front blob to challenge yourself and move the group forward or sit in the pack enjoying the draft for a more relaxing ride. Respect the leaders, keep a positive mindset here and be relentless. Go go Aliens!

name: Vikings Valhalla - A Winter Of Shenanigans
description:

name: 3R Endurance Steady Ride
description:
This is a 3R Group Ride Event. Your co-operation and teamwork is essential to the success of the ride and we ask that no riders ride off the front of the group. The event is designed as part of 3R’s package of #ProStyleTraining events to assist with the attainment of your training goals and may include intervals over and below the ride average parameters. This is not a race so please follow the leader beacon's (Yellow) instructions and if you are feeling strong, please help the keeper beacon (Red) to assist other riders back to the pack. We welcome good banter and aim to create a fun, social atmosphere for your training. We welcome any feedback on our Facebook page https://www.facebook.com/groups/ClubWorldBicycleRelief/ #Team3R #Ride3R #RideRaceRaise.
#3r

The A category ride is for riders looking for a ride comparable to a ride in real life, going easy on flats and hard on the climbs.

Mostly not fenced to have the opportunities for PRs.

A minimum FTP of 4.0w/kg is recommended.

name: SZR  Endurance Ride
description:
The goal with the SZR Endurance Ride is to focus on the Group and keeping the Group together while having fun to make the time fly fast!

The SZR Endurance Ride is divided into C, D and E categories, the tempo is shown next to the ride category, this is rider weight / gender dependant.

Please make sure you choose the correct group when signing up for this ride.

Note that the average is for the total ride! There might be variations above or under the average during the ride.

- This is a social group ride and not a race. Staying close to the ride leader is the key. Respect and support the group!
- Follow the ride leaders instructions at all times.
- After steep hills we focus on getting the group together. Soft pedal if ahead to regroup faster.
- In case of a drop-out or any other issues, we do have great sweep support to help you back to the group!

Communication is the key so make sure you can call (chat message) out for help and do it as soon as possible.

Use our discord if you like to have a real talk with the people on the ride:
https://discord.gg/DQHybQT
You'll find us in the Endurance Ride C/D/E channels

name: Bikealicious Rubber Band Joy Ride
description:
The Saturday edition of the weekly Joy Ride tackles some of the longer routes in Zwift with everything you’d expect from the Joy Ride crew! Our mission is to push you further than before, build your endurance, and have fun. If you are feeling strong, push to the front and drag the group, if not, just sit in the peloton.

We have the “rubber-band” activated, which means that no matter what level you are, you will be able to keep up, and the group WILL STAY TOGETHER. The rubber band allows you to ride at your own pace, slow or fast, and you are guaranteed to stay in the group.

The ride speed may be slightly less than other group rides due to the rubber band effect, but that’s a small price to pay to allow riders of all levels to remain together throughout the ride. We are all about teamwork, working together as a group, and we look forward to riding with you!

name: EVO CC Fusion Endurance Ride! [2.2-2.4w/kg avg]
description:
Welcome to the Evolution Cycling Club [EVO] Fusion Endurance Ride. The ride is geared towards Zwifter’s that are looking for a steady paced ride within a friendly group ride setting, like a coffee ride. The average for the ride will be between 2.2-2.4w/kg depending on riders weight, course and leader. The ride course may vary and at times may include more hillier rides therefore the watts per kilo may be above/below the advertised figures as they are only an average.

The group is based upon high social interaction so bring your best banter. Please use the companion app or a keyboard to communicate in-ride.

name: Velos Sofa to Saddle ride.
description:
Welcome to Team Velos, this is a gentle ride aimed at newcomers or novice cyclists who are starting out on their Zwift journey. We will start off at .8 w/kg and we will very gradually raise the pace to 1.3 w/kg maximum over the 45 minutes. Our Team will answer any questions you have regarding your Zwift set up and guide you through the wonderful worlds of Zwift. The ride will hopefully give you the encouragement to leave that comfy sofa and build your strength to join our faster rides in the future, our team will encourage you and help with every pedal stroke to reach your goal.

It’s not a race and there is nothing to win here just the satisfaction of getting off the sofa early on a Saturday morning and then you can get on with your weekend.

Join our Zwift club at teamvelos.co.uk

name: Grand Masters League
description:
Welcome to the Grand Masters League! Join passionate cyclists from around the world in this race series designed specifically for competitors of all ages. Each week, we will take on challenging courses in different Zwift worlds, testing your endurance, strategy, and speed.

Rules and Race Format
To ensure fair competition and an epic racing experience, these are the rules you must follow:

Riders will be grouped into age categories to ensure balanced and fair competition:

>     Elite (Cat A) → Up to 29 years old
>     M30 (Cat B) → 30 to 39 years old
>     M40 (Cat C) → 40 to 49 years old
>     M50 (Cat D) → 50 to 59 years old
>     M60+ (Cat E) → 60 years old and up

To appear in the official results on ZwiftPower, it is mandatory to:

Be registered on ZwiftPower.
Use a heart rate monitor (HRM).
Connect a smart trainer or power meter as a power source. (Dual recording is encouraged).

Make sure you meet all requirements to avoid disqualification.

name: LA GRUPETTA DE ZABI
description:
🚴‍♂️ ¡Rodamos juntos para disfrutar!

Únete a la GRUPETTA de ZABI, pensada para compartir kilómetros, risas y buen ambiente sobre la bici.

🔸 Goma activada para mantener al grupo unido
🔸 Ritmo cómodo y accesible para todos
🔸 Ideal para conocer gente y rodar en compañía

No importa tu nivel ni tus vatios. Aquí lo importante es el compañerismo, la diversión y disfrutar del ciclismo virtual juntos.

💪 Ponte el maillot, conecta el rodillo y ven a rodar con nosotros.

¡Todos juntos desde la salida hasta la meta!

🚴‍♂️ Let’s ride together and have fun!

Join this ZABI group ride created to share kilometers, good vibes, and an enjoyable cycling experience.

🔸 Rubber band enabled to keep the group together
🔸 Comfortable and inclusive pace
🔸 Perfect for meeting new riders and riding together

Your level or watts don’t matter. What matters here is friendship, fun, and enjoying virtual cycling as a group.

💪 Put on your kit, connect your trainer, and ride with us.

Let’s stay together from start to finish!

name: Watts More Rendurance!
description:
Watts More! Ride with friends in challenging events. Take on your challenge in Watts, elevation or duration!

 

Saturday morning, an endurance ride is the ideal way to start your weekend. We ride together in a steady ride at about 2.4 w/kg AVG on mostly flat tracks.
Ride leaders vary and will cheer you on during this ride that will take exact two hours. All riders are encouraged to keep the bunch together, so we can start and finish as one happy blob.
Everybody is welcome as long as you make a positive contribution in making this a good and relaxed start of the weekend.

 

From October until March these rides are guided with a rideleader. From April until September most rides are without rideleader. In that case don’t argue, blob up and be nice.

 

Check out our weekly ride announcements on the Watts More Facebook https://www.facebook.com/groups/1151203888657006/?ref=share

 

Join Watts More on Zwift https://www.zwift.com/clubs/d6afeaa7-e754-478a-b68d-2a794648fa02/home

Dit is een groepsrit met de focus op bij elkaar blijven. Luister naar de aanwijzingen van de Yellow Beacon en geniet van de chat…
De snelheid van de rit kan variëren maar gemiddeld rijdt
E 1.8 w/kg

name: NO LIMIT CC – SOCIAL - RUBBER BAND & ROLL
description:
👥 No Limit Cycling Club is a community-led cycling club built around consistency, confidence, and riding together. Riders of all backgrounds and abilities are welcome.

🌤 Rubber Band & Roll is a relaxed weekend group ride using Zwift’s Rubber Band feature to help keep the group together. Ride steady with the pack, sit in the draft, or take short pulls knowing the group will regroup. The focus is smooth group riding and good vibes.

🗺 Routes rotate across Zwift worlds including Watopia, France, and Makuri Islands to keep rides fresh and fun.

🧭 Ride leads manage pacing and communication. Sweepers check in with riders and help regroup when needed.

🔒Warm-up around 1.5 w/kg, then settle into 1.8–2.2 w/kg. Fence is on to keep the group together and may be lifted during sprints and towards the end.

Ride leaders vary and will cheer you on during this ride that will take exact two hours. All riders are encouraged to keep the bunch together, so we can start and finish as one happy blob.

name: PAOLO BARBERA & SCANNELLATORI SERIALI WORKOUT
description:
"Scannellatori Seriali" is a large community of cyclists, triathletes, and runners. We invite you to join our community by following our Instagram page at https://www.instagram.com/scannellatori_seriali/ or contacting us on Facebook.
 
Coach Paolo Barbera (Please visit www.heycoach.it )   is a Certified Triathlon and Ironman Coach and the founder of Active Kids, a sporting clinic to help children and adults in the prevention and treatment of obesity through healty nutrition and tailored training programs

Paolo is an experienced thriathlete and cyclist, in 2017 opened an endurance training center in milan, Tri60, specilized in indoor training.

In the last ten years Paolo has developed training programs for triathletes, runners and cyclists. Indoor training plays a key role to control pace, cadence and mental strenght.

Paolo’s workouts are designed to mix different training zones aiming to maximize results in a very short time. Paolo’s coachees by following his workouts, at the right intensity, have achieved challenging results.

name: Team CLS Base 'n' Banter
description:
Base ’n’ Banter is a controlled weekend endurance ride - with a strong community and social focus! 

Across every weekend in 2026, we will continue to offer a mix of rides that cover flat, rolling and hilly terrain with the aim of getting in a solid endurance ride, mostly around 2hrs.

This is a chance to enjoy a friendly experienced group club ride with regulars who have no Big Egos. While you build your fitness, there is always plenty of in-ride banter. 

What pace to expect?
We will ride the flats around 2.5 - 2.7 w/kg with a focus on keeping everyone together!

The leader will climb at around 3.0 - 3.2 w/kg depending on the length and if needed we will always try and regroup after.

While the leader will do everything to keep everyone together, we can't slow repeatedly so some splits are inevitable.

Our SWEEPERS on this ride, known as our ‘ORANGE ARMY’ (OA), are members of TEAM CLS who are dedicated to helping others. If you have had a drop out or accidentally hit a wrong key, type ‘HELP’ and they will come back and offer you a wheel back to the group.

Note: While we always try to ensure this ride is led by one of our beacons there may be some weeks where this is not possible. The ride always has regulars that will ride to the advertised pace!

So if you are prepping for Majorca 312, 225, or 167, or indeed any other Grand Fondo, join us and get some distance and hills in your legs.

This is your ride as much as the groups, if you want to go off the front, feel free to see how long you can stay away, if you want to hit some sprints, get stuck in. Feel free to chat about bike choice, fuelling, strategy, hotels, pubs, karaoke and anything else you like.

name: ZZRC Bring a Bidon Social Ride
description:
Welcome to our ZZRC Bring a Bidon 2.4-2.7. This is a group ride, not a race, where we encourage riding together.

Our rides are open to all riders, the category enforcement merely allows us to ensure a safe and quality ride for you the riders and for our group.

In 2015 ZZRC was founded and are one of the oldest established clubs on Zwift .

YELLOW BEACON will pace between 2.4-2.7 on the ride , with a possible increase of watts on inclines or sprints , but the average for the whole ride will be as advertised

We strongly promote group riding so on most of our rides we will use the Fence to help encourage that. Using a fence ensures that the ride is not over paced .

In the event of falling off the back of the main group , you will need to pace well over group pace to bridge the gap and catch .

This is where our awesome ZZRC sweeps and Ride Buddies will help you return to group using their draft. They will give you clear encouraging instructions to aid this process .

Our crew are a caring bunch who dedicate a lot of hours to this club , but want you to have the best ride experience on Zwift

You will be fully supported and encouraged throughout the ride by the Leader, Sweeps and Ride Buddies .

Our rides do not allow the use of TT Bikes as they do not draft and will require you to push harder on the ride, and in these instances our Sweeps will not be able to help you .

Mountain bikes operate very similarly, minimum draft so more watts (effort) will be required for the ride and any chase backs to group .

All our rides have a 30 minute late join feature which allows you to rejoin if you have technical issues or you find yourself out of the group in the early stages of the ride. Using this feature SHOULD teleport you back into the main group with our YELLOW BEACON .


We love to have a chat on our rides so join us
on Discord: https://discord.gg/QdeS3PtXTX


TOP TIPS

1) Stay close to the ride leader (or just in front on climbs), don’t let a gap form and the elastic snap!

2) Stay away from the Fence – We don’t like to fry anyone

3) Most important of all . . . HAVE FUN AND ENJOY THE RIDE.

#zzrc

Don’t forget to join our ZZRC-We Pace Not Race Facebook page and our club on the companion app

name: DBR Saturday Race
description:
Welcome to DBR Saturday Race.

All RS categories will start at the same time. Expect each race to be highly competitive and have fun.

Categories
Each race will be using Zwift Racing Score (ZRS) for categorization.
race up a category, if your RS is at the top end of a category. Or if you simply desire an added challenge.

- A: 1000 =< 690
- B:690<520
- C:520<350
- D:350<180
- E:180<=0

Your Zwift Racing Score is determined by how much success you have in races.
better against people with higher ZRS, then your ZRS may increase. If you place worse than people with lower ZRS, then your score might decrease. Read more about ZRS here - https://support.zwift.com/en_us/racing-score-faq-BkG9_Rqrh <https://support.zwift.com/en_us/racing-score-faq-BkG9_Rqrh>

If your ZRS increases past a category boundary during the series, your points earned will not transfer to the new category with you.

RULES:
Smart trainer or power meter is required. zPower will be removed.
Heart rate monitors are compulsory for all categories.
No TT bikes unless it's a TT event.
You need to have a registered account with Zwiftpower.com and accept their terms and conditions to be in the results of the race.

Misc.
Race organizers may request riders in all categories to provide a dual recording or a matching RL effort (Strava) in order to verify a Zwift race effort. Failure to comply may result in disqualification from the event. Failure to provide a dual recording or RL effort on three requests may result in disqualification from future events, until a dual recording with a matching effort is provided.
Race organizers may exclude a rider from the results, due to poor sportsmanship. Examples may be bad language, sandbagging or other behavior of a disruptive manner.

name: TeamPTz - Joaquim Agostinho Ride
description:
Joaquim Agostinho, 1943~1984, ciclista de elite Português. Entre muitas homenagens, sabias que sempre que sobes o ADZ, 14.ª curva do Alpe d'Huez, podes ver o Busto de J.A., em homenagem à sua vitoria desta mítica etapa no Tour em 1979, (na classificação geral terminou em 3º).

Temos todo o gosto em te convidar para te juntares a nós neste passeio de convívio, em homenagem ao J.A.. Deverás pedalar junto do leader e poderás juntar-te a nós no Discord: https://discord.gg/MtBCtBmch8

Joaquim Agostinho, 1943~1984, Top Portuguese cyclist. Among many honors, did you know that whenever you climd ADZ, turn 14º Alpe d’Huez, you can see J.A. statue, in honour to his victory at 1979 on this mitic stage on tour, (finished overall at 3º).

We are glad to invite you to join us in a social ride, that also honours J.A. You should run together with Leader and you can join us on our Discord server: https://discord.gg/MtBCtBmch8

name: HerD Beginner Races
description:
Where do you go to try racing or to grow a little better with your racing craft… Herd Beginner Races is set up to provide you with that opportunity by using Zwift Racing Scores (ZRS) with bandwidths that are set up so you’re competing with people of similarities and routes that enable you to challenge yourself and grow with racing. Our pens are set up so you're racing with others of similar abilities. Zwift will recommend your pen in blue; you can race in a higher up pen but it's not recommended.

Each week HBR races will have a different focus; racing on a flat route, rolling/undulating with a small climbs, and a route that is commonly used in many Zwift racing events. In addition, the last race of the month will be Tick-Tock so that you can monitor your performance.

name: Madhare Saturday Hill Training
description:
Join our Madhare sessions every Tuesday and Saturday as part of our weekly Autumn/Winter training for new and experienced Zwifters.
Saturday's
Each Week you take on the MUIR AND THE MOUNTAIN...Start off settling into a rhythm for the first few weeks. Getting up and over the summit is the key. Then, start improving your time week-on-week. Start adding in some attacks whilst climbing. Before the spring you'll be attacking the climb all the way up and smashing your PB!
Our beacon is there to set a pace and to talk all things cycling so jump on and join in!
It's not a race, however, if you want to zip off ahead or drop back and relax you can do that too!
*Cat C - 1 - 5w/kg - All Cats'
Join the Mad Hare official Zwift club! Email or follow one of our leaders for an invite.

name: Newbury Velo Weekend TT
description:
NEWBURY VELO CLUB TIME TRIALS

Newbury Velo presents your weekly 10 mile TT (and a bit...). No marshals, no sign-on. No fee.

Club results will be posted on our Facebook Page: https://www.facebook.com/newburyvelo 

Riders must be registered on https://www.zwiftpower.com and have their Zwift profile agreed to share with zwiftpower otherwise they will not be included in the results.  Think of it as the signing in process :) details of how to do this can be found here: https://boltrace.team/zwift-power-guide

THE TT HUD

Time Trials offer a unique HUD (Heads Up Display) that emphasizes that this is a race against the clock! You'll also see intermediate timing checkpoints. In Bologna, there are eight of these - one every 1km; in Watopia on the Tempus Fugit course, there are four - each one breaking up the course at a distinct landmark. A center clock timing you to 100ths of a second will keep you on task and you can use the minimap to track your progress.

CORE RULES

* Rather than having an Event start time, each rider will receive their own individual start time when signing up in Zwift Companion; you can still sign up on the web or in-game, but you won't be shown your explicit start time until you enter the paddocks.
* Drafting is disabled for all Zwift Time Trials.
* Time Trial bikes are not required. You can use any bike in your Garage.
* Results for time trials are pending until all riders have finished. You'll see other riders populate the results screen as they finish and your placing will be updated accordingly.

#newburyvelo

name: DIRT 505 Saturday Endurance Ride
description:
Welcome to the DIRT 505 Saturday Endurance Special Edition Ride!

Please join us weekly on Saturdays at a pace of 2.6-2.8w/kg for 120 minutes.

The 505 rides take place Monday, Wednesday, Thursday and Friday for 90 minutes at the same time and same consistent pace. Saturday's we ride for 120 minutes.

We kick off our rides with a 5 minute pace at 2.2w/kg to get us warmed up and together as a team. The fence is used throughout the ride to keep everyone together. The fence will not kick you off the ride but we do encourage all our riders to stay together as close to the beacon as possible. Our rides offer a 30 minute late join option.
The ride leader will stay as close to ride pace as possible. We try to change up the routes each week and some of the routes may include some small to moderate climbs.

Our group exists to encourage and build up cyclists around the world no matter your time zone, fitness level, pro or amateur. We exist to encourage and build up a team culture of unity in the cycling community.

STRAVA DIRT CLUB:

https://www.strava.com/clubs/zwiftdirt

FACEBOOK DIRT GROUP:

https://www.facebook.com/groups/zwiftdirt

eventSubgroups.name: DIRT 505 Saturday Endurance Ride (C)
eventSubgroups.description:
Welcome to the DIRT 505 Saturday Endurance Ride!

Please join us weekly on Saturdays at a pace of 2.8w/kg for 120 minutes.

The 505 rides take place Monday, Wednesday, Thursday and Friday for 90 minutes, same time/pace/vibe.

Saturday is a special 2 hour edition, same time/pace/vibe.

We kick off our rides with a 5 minute pace at 2.2w/kg to get us warmed up and blobbed up as a group. The fence is used throughout the ride to keep everyone together. The fence will not kick you off the ride but we do encourage all our riders to stay together as close to the beacon as possible. Our rides offer a 30 minute late join option. All 505 rides come with complimentary access to an After Ride Party where you can ride extra distance with your fellow 505 teammates.

The yellow beacon team leader will ride the entirety of the ride as close to 2.8w/kg as possible. Some of the rides have a few minor climbs where the w/kg can fluctuate.

Our rides offer sweepers to help pull you back to the blob if you need assistance. Please speak up during the ride if you are in need of a sweep. No speaky, no sweepy.

Team DIRT is an acronym for Dads Indoors Riding Trainers. The 505 rides began under the Team DIRT banner. The group name “505” was created by riders in the 5:05am eastern time zone. Our group exists to encourage and build up cyclists around the world no matter your time zone, fitness level, pro or amateur. We exist to encourage and build up a team culture of unity in the cycling community.
